revenue_growth.note: Y1-Y2 near-term growth (analyst consensus). For stable businesses, set same as revenue_growth_terminal or omit terminal

revenue_growth_terminal.note: Y5 growth after fade. Hypergrowth → mature decay; mature → unchanged. Omit field for stable businesses (defaults to revenue_growth)

wacc.note: Sector WACC: cost of equity (Rf+β·ERP) weighted by E/(D+E), plus after-tax cost of debt weighted by D/(D+E)

terminal_growth.note: Below long-run US GDP ~2.5%; never above Rf

net_debt.note: Total debt (current+non-current+CP) - (Cash + marketable securities). Negative = net cash.

tax_rate.note: Provision for income taxes / Income before tax

buyback_yield.note: Annual share reduction rate: $ buybacks per year / market cap. Negative = net issuance (SBC > buybacks). Default 0 for businesses without programs.

sbc_pct_revenue.note: Stock-based comp / revenue. SBC is real economic cost OCF math hides. Tech 3-10%, industrials <1%, retail ~0.1%. Subtracted from FCFF margin per year.

expected_output.tolerance_rationale: ±50% around hand-DCF — wide because DCF inherently imprecise vs market multiples
